name: com.globalluxagency/luxury-travel-tools
title: Luxury Travel Tools by Global Lux Agency
description: Free luxury travel calculators: yacht charter cost, UK TOMS VAT, commission, RevPAR, safari and more

tools.name: yacht-charter-cost-calculator
tools.description: Estimates the all-in cost of a crewed yacht charter from the headline charter fee. Adds the charter tax for the cruising area (sourced default, overridable), APA (advance provisioning allowance), delivery fees, per-guest local fees, other costs and a crew gratuity, and returns totals per guest and per guest per day. It does not fetch live prices or availability. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/yacht-charter-cost-calculator

charterFee.description: Headline charter fee as quoted, excluding tax, in the quote currency.

area.description: Cruising area: croatia (Croatia), greece (Greece), italy (Italy), france (France & Monaco), spain (Spain & Balearics), montenegro (Montenegro), turkey (Türkiye), bahamas (Bahamas), bvi (British Virgin Islands), usvi (US Virgin Islands).

currency.description: Quote currency (ISO 4217). Defaults to the area's usual quote currency.

taxRate.description: Charter tax rate in percent. Defaults to the cruising area's sourced rate; required where no reliable default exists.

percentOutsideEu.description: For areas taxed pro rata by time in EU waters: % of charter time outside EU waters (must be provable).

apaPercent.description: APA as % of the charter fee. Typical range 25–40%; the default of 30% is a modelling choice.

tipPercent.description: Crew gratuity as % of the charter fee (MYBA guideline 5–15%).

deliveryFee.description: Delivery or redelivery fee, taxed like the charter fee.

perPersonPerDayFee.description: Local fee per guest per day (e.g. a cruising permit). Defaults to the area's sourced fee when quoting in USD, otherwise 0.

otherCosts.description: Anything else outside the APA (flights, transfers, special requests).

tools.name: toms-vat-calculator
tools.description: Per-package estimate of VAT under the UK Tour Operators’ Margin Scheme (HMRC VAT Notice 709/5). Works out the margin, apportions it between UK and non-UK margin scheme supplies and in-house supplies by cost, and applies the VAT fraction (one-sixth at 20%) to the UK share. The real liability is calculated annually across all packages; this is guidance only, not tax advice. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/toms-vat-calculator

sellingPrice.description: Total price charged to the customer for the package, including any VAT.

ukCosts.description: Bought-in margin scheme supplies enjoyed in the UK, at what you paid including VAT.

nonUkCosts.description: Bought-in margin scheme supplies enjoyed outside the UK, at what you paid.

inHouseCosts.description: Direct cost of in-house supplies (your own resources), excluding VAT you can reclaim.

inHouseTreatment.description: VAT treatment of the in-house supplies under the normal rules.

vatRate.description: VAT rate in percent for standard-rated elements. Defaults to the UK standard rate (20%).

currency.description: Currency of the amounts (VAT returns are in sterling).

tools.name: payment-timeline-builder
tools.description: Builds a dated payment and cancellation timeline for a trip: deposit, optional instalments and balance (with client due dates set a buffer ahead of the supplier deadlines) and the cancellation charge that applies on each date. Default terms are examples only; pass the terms from the supplier contract. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/payment-timeline-builder

bookingDate.description: Booking date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

depositType.description: Whether depositValue is a percentage of the total or a fixed amount.

depositValue.description: Deposit due at booking (percent or amount; example default 25%).

balanceDaysBefore.description: Balance due this many days before departure.

instalments.description: Optional extra instalments as "daysBefore:percent" pairs, e.g. "120:25" (up to 6).

clientBufferDays.description: Ask the client this many days before each supplier deadline.

cancellation.description: Cancellation tiers as "daysBefore:percentForfeited" pairs (up to 8), e.g. "84:25,56:50,29:75,0:100".

today.description: Reference date for flagging deadlines that have passed, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: direct-booking-vs-ota-calculator
tools.description: Compares the net room revenue a hotel keeps per booking from an OTA (after commission and, for pay-at-hotel bookings, card fees) and from a direct booking (after rate discount, booking engine, marketing, per-booking costs and card fees). Returns annual distribution costs by channel, the saving from moving a number of percentage points of room nights from OTAs to direct, and break-even direct costs. Direct-channel costs start at 0: pass your own. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/direct-booking-vs-ota-calculator

roomNights.description: Room nights sold per year, all channels.

adr.description: Average daily rate (room revenue per occupied room night).

otaSharePercent.description: Share of room nights booked through OTAs, %. Default: 22.2% (five-star hotels in Europe, 2023).

otaCommissionPercent.description: OTA commission, % of booking value, including any visibility programme uplift. Typical 15–30%; the default of 18% is a modelling choice.

otaPayment.description: 'ota' = prepaid to the OTA, which pays you net; 'property' = pay at hotel, you take the card payment.

cardFeePercent.description: Card processing fee, % of the amount charged (example default 1.5%).

cardFeeFixed.description: Card processing fee, fixed amount per booking (example default 0.2, in GBP).

directDiscountPercent.description: Direct-booking rate discount (e.g. member rate), % off the ADR.

bookingEnginePercent.description: Booking engine fee, % of direct booking value.

marketingPercent.description: Metasearch, paid search and other marketing, % of direct booking value.

directCostPerBooking.description: Fixed cost per direct booking (cost-per-click spend, per-booking engine fee, perk value).

shiftPoints.description: Percentage points of room nights moved from OTAs to direct (example default 5).

tools.name: experience-pricing-calculator
tools.description: Prices a private or small-group experience from its costs. Takes fixed costs per departure, variable costs per guest and overhead, then returns the net price per guest that hits a target margin, the public (rack) price that still leaves that net after the agent or OTA commission (grossing up, not adding commission on top), the break-even group size, and a table of cost, price and profit for each group size. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/experience-pricing-calculator

fixedCostsPerDeparture.description: Costs paid once per departure whatever the group size (guide, vehicle, venue hire, permits), in total.

variableCostsPerGuest.description: Costs paid for each guest (tickets, meals, tastings), in total per guest.

overheadPerDeparture.description: Share of business overheads allocated to each departure.

pricingGuests.description: Group size the suggested net price is based on.

targetMarginPercent.description: Target margin, % of the net price you receive (default 30% is a modelling choice).

commissionPercent.description: Commission the agent or OTA keeps, % of the public price (default 20% is a modelling choice; see sources for typical ranges).

netPriceOverride.description: Your own net price per guest. 0 = use the suggested price.

tools.name: luxury-trip-budget-estimator
tools.description: Totals a luxury trip budget from your own quotes and estimates, with a contingency, and returns the total, per person, per night, per person per night and the cost on the ground (excluding flights and insurance), plus each category’s share. It does not supply prices: pass the amounts from your quotes. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/luxury-trip-budget-estimator

roomRate.description: Accommodation per room per night, including taxes and service charges.

guidingPerDay.description: Private guiding and experiences per day, for the whole party.

guidingDays.description: Days with private guiding or experiences (capped at nights + 1).

diningPerPersonPerDay.description: Dining and drinks per person per day, counted for each night.

feesPerPerson.description: Park, permit and entry fees per person, whole trip.

insurancePerPerson.description: Travel insurance per person, whole trip.

contingencyPercent.description: Contingency, % of every other cost (default 10% is a planning choice, not a benchmark).

tools.name: jet-lag-planner
tools.description: Builds a jet lag plan from the home and destination time zones, the flight’s local departure and arrival times and the traveller’s usual sleep. Returns the body-clock shift needed, the direction (advance or delay), and for each day before departure, the travel day and the days after arrival: a sleep window, light to seek, light to avoid and an optional caffeine cut-off. Based on published circadian research; general guidance, not medical advice. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/jet-lag-planner

homeTimeZone.description: IANA time zone at home, e.g. Europe/London.

destinationTimeZone.description: IANA time zone at the destination, e.g. Asia/Dubai.

departure.description: Departure, local time at home, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

arrival.description: Arrival, local time at the destination, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

wakeTime.description: Usual wake time at home, HH:MM (24-hour).

preflightDays.description: Days before departure to start shifting sleep (0 = none; 2–3 suggested).

strategy.description: Shift the body clock earlier (advance), later (delay), or let the planner choose (auto).

tools.name: travel-agent-commission-calculator
tools.description: Two ways of earning on a booking. mode=commission: from a selling price and commission %, returns the commission, supplier net, margin and equivalent markup. mode=net: from a net cost and a target margin or markup, returns the selling price, profit, margin and markup, plus the price if the percentage were applied on the other basis. Both apply the advisor’s share of a host agency or consortium split. Commission and split defaults are modelling choices, not industry facts; pass the rates in the user’s agreements. Before tax. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/travel-agent-commission-calculator

mode.description: commission = supplier pays a % of the selling price; net = you mark up a net rate.

sellingPrice.description: mode=commission: the commissionable price the client pays.

commissionPercent.description: mode=commission: commission as a % of the selling price. Default 10 is a modelling choice.

netCost.description: mode=net: what the supplier charges you.

targetBasis.description: mode=net: whether targetPercent is a margin (on price) or a markup (on cost).

targetPercent.description: mode=net: target margin (max 95) or markup (max 1000) in percent.

advisorSharePercent.description: Share of the commission or markup the advisor keeps after a host agency or consortium split; 100 = no split. Default 80 is a modelling choice.

tools.name: currency-exposure-calculator
tools.description: For a travel booking sold to the client in one currency (e.g. GBP) with supplier costs in another (e.g. EUR), returns the margin at the quoted rate, at the rate now and when the client currency moves up or down by each scenario percentage, the break-even rate, the margin at risk from the largest adverse move, and an optional comparison with a locked rate. Rates are units of supplier currency per 1 unit of client currency and must be supplied by the caller (no live or reference rates are provided). A deposit or balance already paid or fixed is entered with its rate and is no longer exposed. Not financial or hedging advice. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/currency-exposure-calculator

supplierCost.description: Total supplier cost, in the supplier currency.

supplierCurrency.description: Currency the supplier is paid in.

clientPrice.description: Price agreed with the client, in the client currency.

quotedRate.description: Rate used when quoting: units of supplier currency per 1 unit of client currency (e.g. 1.18 for 1 GBP = 1.18 EUR). Ignored when the currencies match.

rateNow.description: Rate now, or the rate you expect to pay at, same convention. Defaults to quotedRate.

depositPercent.description: Share of the supplier cost due as a deposit, %; the rest is the balance (example default 30%).

depositFixedRate.description: Rate at which the deposit was paid or fixed; 0 = still open.

balanceFixedRate.description: Rate at which the balance was paid or fixed; 0 = still open.

lockedRate.description: Optional locked rate to compare for the open amount (e.g. a rate offered by your FX provider); 0 = none.

scenarioMoves.description: Comma-separated % moves in the client currency, each applied up and down from the rate now (up to 6; example default "2,5,10").

today.description: Reference date for days to each payment, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: package-travel-regulations-checker
tools.description: Applies the decision tree in the Package Travel and Linked Travel Arrangements Regulations 2018 (as amended by SI 2026/455 from 6 April 2027). Returns the outcome (package, linked-travel-arrangement, neither or outside-scope), the regulation that decides it, the reasoning steps and the organiser or trader duties that follow. Guidance only, not legal advice; it does not judge borderline facts such as whether a tourist service is an essential feature. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/package-travel-regulations-checker

rules.description: Which rules apply, by the date the contract is concluded. "from-2027-04-06" applies the 2026 amendments (no linked travel arrangements).

sameTrip.description: All the services are for the same trip or holiday.

transport.description: Includes carriage of passengers (flight, train, coach, ferry, transfer).

flight.description: The transport includes a flight (ATOL pointer). Ignored if transport is false.

accommodation.description: Includes accommodation that is not part of the carriage and not residential.

vehicleHire.description: Includes car, motor vehicle or motorcycle hire.

otherTourist.description: Includes other tourist services (excursions, tours, tickets, ski passes, spa treatments).

otherSignificant.description: The other tourist service is a significant proportion of the value (rule of thumb 25%+) or an essential feature. Only relevant with exactly one of transport, accommodation or vehicle hire.

otherAfterStart.description: The other tourist service was selected and bought after the transport, stay or car hire had started (reg. 2(6)(b)).

combination.description: How the services were put together. One of: single-contract, single-point-of-sale, inclusive-price, sold-as-package, gift-box, data-passed-24h, separate-payment-single-visit, targeted-link-24h, separately-booked.

under24Hours.description: Covers less than 24 hours with no overnight accommodation (exclusion, reg. 3(2)(a)).

notForProfit.description: Offered occasionally, not for profit, to a limited group (exclusion, reg. 3(2)(b)).

generalAgreement.description: Bought under a general agreement for business travel (exclusion, reg. 3(2)(c)).

tools.name: flight-arrival-time-calculator
tools.description: Converts a local departure time and a journey time into the local arrival date and time at the destination, using IANA time-zone rules (including daylight saving on the exact dates). Alternatively, pass the local arrival time to get the journey time. Returns the time difference when landing (which can exceed 12 hours across the date line), the calendar-day change as airlines show it (+1, +2, −1), a plain-English explanation and any clock-change notes. Does not look up flights or schedules. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/flight-arrival-time-calculator

departureTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the departure airport, e.g. Pacific/Auckland.

arrivalTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the arrival airport, e.g. Pacific/Honolulu.

departure.description: Departure, local time at the departure airport, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

flightHours.description: Journey time, whole hours (use with flightMinutes). Ignored if arrival is given.

arrival.description: Optional: arrival, local time at the destination, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. If given, the journey time is worked out from it.

tools.name: revpar-calculator
tools.description: From rooms, nights in the period, room nights sold and rooms revenue, returns occupancy (sold ÷ available), ADR (rooms revenue ÷ sold) and RevPAR (rooms revenue ÷ available, = ADR × occupancy). Optional total revenue gives TRevPAR and the rooms share of revenue; optional gross operating profit gives GOPPAR and GOP margin (null when not supplied). With a target RevPAR, returns the ADR needed at a given occupancy (default: actual) and the occupancy needed at the current ADR. Rooms sold are capped at rooms available. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/revpar-calculator

nights.description: Nights (days) in the period, e.g. 30 or 365.

roomNightsSold.description: Room nights sold in the period.

totalRevenue.description: Total hotel revenue, all departments. 0 = not supplied.

grossOperatingProfit.description: Gross operating profit (USALI), can be negative. 0 = not supplied.

targetOccupancyPercent.description: Occupancy, %, for the target ADR. 0 = use the actual occupancy.

tools.name: hotel-overbooking-calculator
tools.description: Models each booking as showing independently with probability 1 − (no-show % + late-cancellation %) (binomial). For each overbooking level it returns the expected shows, the probability of walking at least one guest, expected walks, expected rooms occupied and the expected net gain (room revenue less walk cost) compared with not overbooking, and recommends the level that maximises it: the newsvendor critical-ratio rule, adding bookings while P(shows ≥ rooms) < revenue ÷ (revenue + walk cost). The rates and costs are the caller's own; nothing is assumed. Assumes demand fills the extra bookings. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/hotel-overbooking-calculator

rooms.description: Rooms available to sell for the night.

noShowPercent.description: No-shows, % of bookings on the books for the night (your own history).

lateCancelPercent.description: Cancellations too late to resell, % of bookings on the books for the night.

roomRevenue.description: Revenue from one extra room sold (e.g. ADR net of VAT).

walkCost.description: All-in cost of walking one guest: relocation room, transport, goodwill and compensation.

tools.name: hotel-upsell-revenue-calculator
tools.description: For five offers ("upgrade" for room upgrades, "earlyLate" check-in/check-out, "spa", "dining" and experiences, airport "transfer"), sales = arrivals × take-up %, revenue = sales × average price, contribution = revenue less direct cost %. Revenue is split pre-arrival vs front desk; platform commission applies to pre-arrival revenue, a staff incentive to front-desk revenue, and a fixed monthly platform fee (×12 for a year). Returns revenue, profit, revenue and profit per arrival, and, with room nights available, RevPAR uplift (upgrades and early/late only, a modelling choice) and TRevPAR uplift (all offers). Default take-up rates are illustrative examples, not benchmarks: pass your own. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/hotel-upsell-revenue-calculator

arrivals.description: Arrivals (stays checking in) in the period.

period.description: Period the arrivals cover; the fixed monthly fee is ×12 for a year.

upgradeTakeUpPercent.description: Room upgrade: share of arrivals who buy it, %. Default is an illustrative example, not a benchmark. 0 = leave out.

upgradeAveragePrice.description: Room upgrade: average price per sale, net of VAT.

upgradeCostPercent.description: Room upgrade: direct cost of delivery, % of price.

earlyLateTakeUpPercent.description: Early check-in / late check-out: share of arrivals who buy it, %. Default is an illustrative example, not a benchmark. 0 = leave out.

earlyLateAveragePrice.description: Early check-in / late check-out: average price per sale, net of VAT.

earlyLateCostPercent.description: Early check-in / late check-out: direct cost of delivery, % of price.

spaTakeUpPercent.description: Spa treatment: share of arrivals who buy it, %. Default is an illustrative example, not a benchmark. 0 = leave out.

spaAveragePrice.description: Spa treatment: average price per sale, net of VAT.

spaCostPercent.description: Spa treatment: direct cost of delivery, % of price.

diningTakeUpPercent.description: Dining and experiences: share of arrivals who buy it, %. Default is an illustrative example, not a benchmark. 0 = leave out.

diningAveragePrice.description: Dining and experiences: average price per sale, net of VAT.

diningCostPercent.description: Dining and experiences: direct cost of delivery, % of price.

transferTakeUpPercent.description: Airport transfer: share of arrivals who buy it, %. Default is an illustrative example, not a benchmark. 0 = leave out.

transferAveragePrice.description: Airport transfer: average price per sale, net of VAT.

transferCostPercent.description: Airport transfer: direct cost of delivery, % of price.

preArrivalSharePercent.description: Share of upsell revenue sold pre-arrival (email/app), %. The rest is front desk.

platformCommissionPercent.description: Upsell platform commission on pre-arrival revenue, %.

platformMonthlyFee.description: Fixed upsell platform fee per month.

frontDeskIncentivePercent.description: Staff incentive on front-desk upsell revenue, %.

roomNightsAvailable.description: Room nights available in the same period, for RevPAR/TRevPAR uplift. 0 = skip.

tools.name: net-rate-sheet-generator
tools.description: Works out the net rate from a retail price (net = retail × (1 − commission)) or the retail price from a net rate (retail = net ÷ (1 − commission)), or the same with a markup on net, then rounds the worked-out price and reports the commission the reseller really keeps after rounding. Optionally prices a child at a % of the adult price. Commission rates are negotiated; the defaults are examples. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/net-rate-sheet-generator

price.description: The price you set, per person or per group, in the terms given by priceEntered.

priceEntered.description: retail = price is the public (rack) price, work out the net; net = price is your net, work out the retail.

model.description: commission = % of the retail price; markup = % added to the net price.

ratePercent.description: Commission or markup %. Commission is capped at 95%. Default 15% is a modelling choice (midpoint of the typical retail travel agent range).

roundTo.description: Round the worked-out price to this step (0 = to 2 decimal places).

childRatePercent.description: Child price as a % of the adult price. 0 = none.

tools.name: yacht-crew-tip-calculator
tools.description: Tipping norms are customs, not rules. Yacht: % of the base charter fee (MYBA guideline 5–15%, 10% standard), split equally across the crew. Villa: % of the villa rental (villa agencies’ guidance roughly 5–15%, low confidence; 10% typical is a modelling choice), split across the staff. Private jet: US$ per pilot and per cabin attendant per flight (US practice, low confidence: pilots $50–100, attendants $30–75), typical at the midpoint; those US$ figures are defaults only when currency is USD and are never converted; other currencies need the caller’s own amounts. Percentages and amounts can be overridden. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/yacht-crew-tip-calculator

context.description: Who is being tipped: yacht (charter crew), jet (private jet crew) or villa (villa staff).

fee.description: Yacht: base charter fee before VAT and APA. Villa: villa rental. Ignored for jet.

currency.description: Currency of the fee or jet amounts. The sourced jet figures are US dollars and are used as defaults only when currency is USD; they are never converted.

staff.description: Crew or staff sharing the tip, for the per-person split (default 8 for yacht, 5 for villa). 0 skips the split.

flights.description: Jet: flights (legs) being tipped for. Use 1 to tip once for the trip.

pilotLow.description: Jet: low tip per pilot per flight, in the chosen currency (default US$50 when currency is USD; needed in other currencies).

pilotHigh.description: Jet: high tip per pilot per flight, in the chosen currency (default US$100 when currency is USD).

attendantLow.description: Jet: low tip per cabin attendant per flight, in the chosen currency (default US$30 when currency is USD).

attendantHigh.description: Jet: high tip per cabin attendant per flight, in the chosen currency (default US$75 when currency is USD).

tools.name: private-jet-vs-first-class-calculator
tools.description: All prices and times are the caller’s own: the tool holds no fares or charter rates, and the defaults are an illustrative example, not quotes. The jet cost (quote + fees + extras) is shared equally; first class is fare + taxes per person, plus group extras. Break-even = ceil((jet total − first-class extras) ÷ (fare + taxes)). Times are per one-way journey and doubled for a return. Optional hourlyValue values each traveller’s hour saved. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/private-jet-vs-first-class-calculator

tripType.description: oneway or return. Return doubles the door-to-door times; prices are for the whole trip either way.

jetQuote.description: Private jet charter quote for the whole aircraft and the whole trip.

jetFees.description: Jet fees not in the quote: taxes, positioning, landing, de-icing.

jetExtras.description: Jet extras for the group: transfers, VIP terminal, catering, pets.

jetSeats.description: Passenger seats on the aircraft quoted.

firstFare.description: First-class fare per person for the whole trip.

firstTaxes.description: First-class taxes and charges per person, if not in the fare.

firstExtras.description: First-class extras for the group: transfers, lounge, excess baggage, pets.

jetBeforeMinutes.description: Jet: time at the airport before departure. Minutes, one way.

jetFlightMinutes.description: Jet: flight time. Minutes, one way.

jetAfterMinutes.description: Jet: time after landing. Minutes, one way.

firstBeforeMinutes.description: First class: time at the airport before departure. Minutes, one way.

firstFlightMinutes.description: First class: flight time including any connection. Minutes, one way.

firstAfterMinutes.description: First class: time after landing (immigration, baggage). Minutes, one way.

hourlyValue.description: Optional value of each traveller’s time per hour; 0 leaves time out of the cost comparison.

tools.name: private-staff-day-rate-calculator
tools.description: Prices private staff from what you pay them. Takes the day or hourly pay, hours per day, overtime threshold and multiplier, employer on-costs %, daily expenses (meals, accommodation, mileage, other), overhead %, and a target margin or markup, then returns the full cost per person per day, the sell price per day and per hour, margin and markup, and totals for the number of staff and days. Holds no market rates: every rate is the caller’s. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/private-staff-day-rate-calculator

role.description: Role label for the estimate (no market rates are applied).

payBasis.description: Whether payRate is per day or per hour.

payRate.description: What you pay the person per day (covering the hours up to overtimeAfterHours) or per hour, before on-costs.

overtimeAfterHours.description: Hours per day paid at the normal rate; later hours are overtime. 0 = no overtime.

overtimeMultiplier.description: Overtime pay multiplier (default 1.5 is a modelling choice).

onCostPercent.description: Employer on-costs (holiday pay, payroll taxes, pension, insurance) as % of pay. Country-specific: enter your own. 0 for a freelancer who invoices.

distancePerDay.description: Distance travelled per day (miles or km).

ratePerDistanceUnit.description: Mileage rate paid per mile or km.

otherExpensesPerDay.description: Other expenses per person per day (parking, tolls, tickets).

overheadPercent.description: Agency or admin overhead as % of direct cost (pay, on-costs, expenses).

pricingMode.description: Price on a margin (% of sell price) or a markup (% of cost).

pricingPercent.description: Target margin or markup % (default 25% is a modelling choice; margins are capped at 95%).

marginOnExpenses.description: false = recharge expenses at cost with no margin.

tools.name: group-trip-cost-splitter
tools.description: Divides one total between up to 12 parties: equally per person, equally per party, by person-nights, or by room weighting × nights (e.g. 1.5 for a master suite). Shares are whole cents (largest-remainder method) and add up exactly to the total. With amounts already paid, returns each party’s balance (paid − share) and settle-up transfers; anything unpaid is owed to the suppliers (to: null). Lists are comma-separated, one value per party, in the same order. The page supports several costs with a method each; this API takes one total. No sourced facts: all figures are the caller’s. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/group-trip-cost-splitter

total.description: The shared cost to split, e.g. the charter fee.

method.description: How to split: person (equally per person), party (equally per party), night (by person-nights), room (by room weighting × nights).

partySizes.description: People in each party, comma-separated, e.g. "2,2,4" (1–50 each, up to 12 parties).

nights.description: Nights (or days) each party is present, comma-separated (default 7 for every party). Used by the night and room methods.

roomWeights.description: Cabin or room weighting per party, comma-separated (default 1; e.g. 1.5 for a master suite). Used by the room method.

paid.description: Amount each party has already paid, comma-separated (default 0).

currency.description: Currency of the amounts (labels only; nothing is converted).

tools.name: safari-planner
tools.description: Ranks 11 well-known safari regions (Masai Mara, Serengeti, Okavango Delta, Greater Kruger and Sabi Sand, Madikwe, Eastern Cape, South Luangwa, Hwange, Etosha, Bwindi, Volcanoes) for a month of travel and priorities, using sourced best and rainy seasons and migration timing, and suggests a route with nights per camp. Wildlife timing varies year to year. No prices, availability, health or entry advice. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/safari-planner

nights.description: Nights in total, including any beach extension.

pace.description: relaxed ≈ 4, balanced ≈ 3, active ≈ 2 nights per camp (a planning choice).

family.description: Family with children under 15: favours malaria-free reserves and excludes gorilla treks (minimum age 15).

malariaFree.description: Malaria-free only: only regions widely described as malaria-free (not health advice).

tools.name: luxury-travel-carbon-calculator
tools.description: Flights: passenger-km × the DESNZ factor for the band and cabin (bands: domestic = within the UK; short = UK to/from Europe and North Africa; long = UK to/from elsewhere; intl = between non-UK countries). Use great-circle km: the factors already include the 8% routing uplift. Domestic has an average factor only; short-haul first uses the first/business factor. Private jet: fuel burned × the aviation turbine fuel factor, per litre or per kg; yacht: litres × the marine gas oil or diesel factor. The caller supplies all fuel figures: the tool holds no fuel burn for any aircraft or yacht. Radiative forcing (default on) applies DESNZ’s 1.7 multiplier to aviation CO2 only. Hotel stay: room-nights × the DESNZ country factor, or the caller’s own kg CO2e per room-night (stayCountry=custom, e.g. for a villa). Excludes well-to-tank emissions. An estimate; offsets are not endorsed. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/luxury-travel-carbon-calculator

travellers.description: Travellers sharing the trip, for the per-person figure.

radiativeForcing.description: Include the 1.7 radiative forcing multiplier on aviation CO2 (flights and jet fuel).

flights.description: Scheduled flight legs separated by ";", each band*cabin*km*passengers, e.g. "long*first*5500*2;short*business*1100*2". Bands: domestic, short, long, intl. Cabins: average, economy, premium, business, first. Up to 6 legs; "none" for no scheduled flights. Defaults to an example long-haul first-class leg.

jetHours.description: Private jet flight hours (used with jetFuelPerHour).

jetFuelPerHour.description: Private jet fuel burn per hour from the operator, in jetFuelUnit.

jetFuelTotal.description: Total jet fuel for the trip, in jetFuelUnit. If above 0, used instead of hours × burn.

yachtHours.description: Yacht engine (and generator) hours, used with yachtLitresPerHour.

yachtLitresPerHour.description: Yacht fuel burn per hour, litres, from the captain or broker.

yachtLitresTotal.description: Total yacht fuel for the charter, litres. If above 0, used instead of hours × burn.

stayCountry.description: Country for the DESNZ hotel-stay factor, or custom to use stayKgPerRoomNight.

stayRooms.description: Rooms occupied (the factor is per room, not per guest).

stayKgPerRoomNight.description: Your own kg CO2e per room-night, used when stayCountry is custom.

tools.name: avios-value-calculator
tools.description: All prices and points are the caller’s own: the tool holds no award charts, fares or room rates, and the defaults are an illustrative example. Value per point = 100 × (cash price − cash paid on the award) ÷ (points used + points the cash booking would earn), in hundredths of the currency. With a target value, net saving = cash saved − points given up × target ÷ 100, and the best option is the highest net saving (or paying cash if none is positive). marginalValue compares each option with the option using fewer points. For Avios with no targetValue given, the target defaults to a published 1p ball-park (opinion, low confidence). Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/avios-value-calculator

programme.description: avios, virgin-points, hotel or other. Labels the result; for avios the default target is a published ball-park value.

currency.description: Currency of all amounts (no conversion). Values per point are in hundredths of it (pence for GBP, cents for EUR/USD).

cashPrice.description: Cash price of the same booking (same flight and cabin, or room and dates).

earnOnCash.description: Points the cash booking would earn (opportunity cost). 0 to ignore.

option1Points.description: Option 1 (“All points”): points used. 0 leaves the option out.

option1Cash.description: Option 1: cash paid with the points (taxes, fees, carrier charges, or the money part of points + money).

option2Points.description: Option 2 (“Points + money”): points used. 0 leaves the option out.

option2Cash.description: Option 2: cash paid with the points (taxes, fees, carrier charges, or the money part of points + money).

option3Points.description: Option 3 (“Another mix”): points used. 0 leaves the option out.

option3Cash.description: Option 3: cash paid with the points (taxes, fees, carrier charges, or the money part of points + money).

targetValue.description: Your target value per point in hundredths of the currency (e.g. pence). 0 = no target. Omitted: 1 for avios (a published ball-park), none otherwise.

tools.name: is-the-upgrade-worth-it-calculator
tools.description: All prices and values are the caller’s own: the tool holds no fares or upgrade prices, and the defaults are an illustrative example. Cash: upgrade cost = upgradedPrice − basePrice (never below 0). Points: upgradePoints × pencePerPoint ÷ 100 + upgradePointsCash. Flight benefits: sleep hours (capped at flight hours, only if sleepMatters = yes) × sleepValuePerHour + flightHours × comfortPerHour + lounge + baggage + fastTrack; hotel benefits: nights × (roomValuePerNight + includedPerNight). Both add flexibility + other. Worth it when benefits ≥ cost. Prices are per person (flight) or for the stay (hotel). Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/is-the-upgrade-worth-it-calculator

upgradeType.description: flight (cabin upgrade) or hotel (room or suite upgrade).

basePrice.description: Price of what is booked now: per person for a flight, for the whole stay for a hotel.

upgradedPrice.description: Cash only: price of the upgraded cabin or room, same basis as basePrice.

upgradePoints.description: Points only: points asked for the upgrade.

upgradePointsCash.description: Points only: cash payable with the points (taxes, surcharges, co-pay).

pencePerPoint.description: Points only: the caller’s own value per point in pence or cents (illustrative default, not a sourced valuation).

flightHours.description: Flight: total flight hours the upgrade covers.

sleepMatters.description: Flight: yes to count the value of extra sleep, no to leave it out.

sleepHours.description: Flight: extra hours of usable sleep expected from the upgrade (capped at flightHours).

sleepValuePerHour.description: Flight: value of each extra hour of sleep (arriving rested).

comfortPerHour.description: Flight: value of extra space, food and quiet per flight hour.

roomValuePerNight.description: Hotel: value of the better room per night.

includedPerNight.description: Hotel: cash saved per night on included extras (breakfast, club lounge).

lounge.description: Flight: value of lounge access, e.g. the day pass otherwise bought.

baggage.description: Flight: value of extra baggage, e.g. the bag fee otherwise paid.

flexibility.description: Value of better change or refund terms.

other.description: Any other saving or value from the upgrade.

tools.name: luxury-packing-list
tools.description: Returns a packing checklist grouped into documents and money, clothing, footwear, toiletries, tech, health, activities, trip-type extras and children, with per-person quantities scaled to the nights and laundry (a planning choice). Trip types can be combined. Includes sourced UK cabin liquids rules and an example light-aircraft safari luggage limit. General guidance: no entry, visa or health advice; check airline and operator rules. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/luxury-packing-list

tools.name: cruise-true-cost-calculator
tools.description: All prices are the caller’s own: the tool holds no cruise fares, gratuity rates, package prices or inclusions, and the defaults are an illustrative example, not quotes. Per option: fare × guests, plus each add-on (per person, per person per night or per booking as described) unless listed in Included, less onboard credit capped at the onboard spend. Returns totals, per person and per person per night, and differences against the cheaper option per person per night. The page compares up to three options. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/cruise-true-cost-calculator

optionAFare.description: Option A: cruise fare per person.

optionAPortTaxes.description: Option A: port taxes and fees, per person, for the cruise.

optionAGratuities.description: Option A: gratuities and service charges, per person per night (or a percentage of the fare, up to 50, when the gratuity basis is percent).

optionADrinks.description: Option A: drinks package or bar spend, per person per night.

optionAInsurance.description: Option A: travel insurance, per person, for the cruise.

optionAOther.description: Option A: other, for the whole booking.

optionAGratuityBasis.description: Option A: pppn (per person per night) or percent (of the fare).

tools.name: where-to-go-on-holiday-by-month
tools.description: Scores each destination out of 100 for the chosen type of trip from its 1991–2020 monthly averages (ERA5 reanalysis, Copernicus C3S, CC BY 4.0): average daytime high against an ideal range per trip type, sea temperature for beaches, monthly rainfall above 60 mm and daytime cloud. The weights are modelling choices. avoidRain drops places in their rainy season that month: ≥ 180 mm, or ≥ 16 rainy days with ≥ 100 mm (not ski). Flying time is an estimate from great-circle distance (850 km/h + 0.5 h), not a schedule. Averages, not a forecast; no prices or availability. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/where-to-go-on-holiday-by-month

month.description: Month of travel, lower case (january … december).

tripType.description: any, beach, city, ski or safari. "any" scores each place on its best type.

region.description: Limit to a region, or any.

avoidRain.description: Leave out places in their rainy season that month.

maxFlightHours.description: Maximum estimated non-stop flying time from London Heathrow in hours; 0 for no limit.
